y'Ukwizera n'Imirimo
about.p1: Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda (CPR) yashinzwe mu 1963, ni umuzimwa uhuza amatorero 25 y'abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda. Kuva yashingwa, CPR yagize uruhare rukomeye mu mibereho y'abaturage — kubaka imiryango nyuma y'amakimbirane, guteza imbere uburezi, no kubumbatira agaciro ka buri muntu.
about.p2Start: Uyu munsi, binyuze mu mashami yayo y'uburezi, ubuzima, ivugabutumwa, n'itumanaho, CPR igera mu ntara zose z'u Rwanda. Intego yacu —

whoWeAre.title: Kuri Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda
whoWeAre.p1: Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda (CPR) yashinzwe mu 1963 ngo iteze imbere kandi isangize abantu ibikorwa bishya z'iterambere n'oserivisi z'ingenzi mu matorero yacu n'abaturage bose.
whoWeAre.p2: Twiyemeje kubaka ubufatanye bukomeye no gutanga serivisi zo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu gushyigikira ukwizera, ubumwe, n'iterambere rirambye mu Rwanda hose.

visionMission.title: Icyerekezo n'Inshingano
visionMission.visionDesc: Umuryango w'abanyarwanda wunze ubumwe, wizerwa, kandi uteye imbere aho buri muntu aba mu cyubahiro n'amahoro.
visionMission.missionDesc: Guhuza amatorero y'abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda ngo tugire uruhare rugaragara mu ivugabutumwa, uburezi, ubuzima, n'iterambere rusange w'imibereho n'ubukungu.

model.title: Uburyo Twukora
model.desc: Uburyo bwo guhuza ubufatanye bhuza amatorero n'amatsinda ku ntego zo gufasha abaturage.
model.step1Desc: Amatorero y'abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda yunze ubumwe mu murongo umwe.
model.step2Desc: Umutungo n'ubushobozi bokusanyirizwa mu misanzu y'imbere mu gihugu n'ubufatanye mpuzamahanga.
model.step3Desc: Imishinga irambye yibanda ku baturage ishyirwa mu bikorwa mu nzego zose.

items.title: Ukwizera
items.desc: Shingiye ku nyigisho zacu za gikristu, ukwizera kuyobora ibikorwa n'ibyemezo byacu byose.

items.title: Ubumwe
items.desc: Guhuza amatorero atandukanye ngo avuge kandi akore mu ijwi rimwe.

items.title: Inyangamugayo
items.desc: Gushyigikira mucungire yera n'ubwiyunge mu ibikorwa byacu byose.

items.title: Ubwisungane / Serivisi
items.desc: Wiyemeje gukorera abafite intege nke mu mbabazi n'urukundo.

items.title: Ubunyangamugayo / Ireme
items.desc: Guharanira ireme ryo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu uburezi, ubuzima, n'imishinga y'iterambere.

execCommittee.title: Komite Nyobozi
execCommittee.desc: Ikipe yacu y'abanyamwuga n'abayobozi b'amatorero izana ubushobozi butandukanye gushyigikira inshingano z a CPR.

newsroom.noNewsFound: Nta nkuru zabonetse mu iki cyiciro.

departmentsPage.heroDesc: Amashami arindwi akomeye ajyana inshingano za CPR mu burezi, iterambere, imari, urubyiruko, uburinganire, itumanaho, n'imiyoborere.
departmentsPage.introDesc: Ibikorwa bya CPR bikorwa binyuze mu mashami arindwi yihariye, buri shami riyobowe n'impuguke zifite uburambe. Hamwe, bashyira mu bikorwa gahunda zigera mu ntara zose z'u Rwanda, uhereye ku burezi n'ubuzima kugeza ku gufasha urubyiruko n'iterambere ry'abaturage.

cta.title: Korana n'Amashami Yacu
cta.desc: Mu burezi, iterambere, ubuzima, cyangwa gufasha urubyiruko — umuryango wawe ushobora gutanga umusanzu hamwe n'amashami y'CPR.

gs.title: Ibiro by'Ubunyamabanga Bukuru
gs.desc: Umunyamabanga Mukuru atanga ubuyobozi bw'ingamba, ahuza ibikorwa by'amashami yose, kandi ahagararira CPR ku rwego rw'igihugu no mpuzamahanga.
body: Gushyiraho ingamba n'imiyoborere mu matorero yose agize CPR
Guhuza Inteko Rusange, Komite Nyobozi, n'inama za Biro
Guhagararira mu mahuriro ya leta, mpuzamahanga, n'ubukristo
Ibibazo by'amategeko, abakozi, n'itumanaho ry'inzego
Gushaka abafatanyabikorwa mu nzego z'imbere n'iz'amahanga
Gukurikirana raporo z'umwaka, igenzura, n'imikorere y'inzego

bnep.title: Ibiro by'Igihugu by'Uburezi bw'Abaporotesitanti (BNEP)
bnep.desc: BNEP ni ishami ry'uburezi rya CPR, rikuriikirana amashuri abanza n'ayisumbuye y'abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda hose. Rifite amashuri abanza 595+ n'ayisumbuye menshi, BNEP ibaka ejo hazaza h'abana b'u Rwanda binyuze mu burezi bushingiye ku kwizera.
body: Gukurikirana amashuri abanza 595+ n'ayisumbuye mu gihugu hose
Amahugurwa mu myigishirize igezweho (PAP) ku barimu
Guteza imbere gahunda y'imyigishirize y'idini rya gikristu
Igenzura ry'ikigo, kwemeza ireme, no gushyira mu bikorwa amahame y'uburezi
Gahunda z'uburezi bw'abana bato n'ibigo by'indahemuka by'abarezi
Gufatanya na REB, UNICEF, n'abaterankunga mpuzamahanga

diakonia.title: Diyakoniya / Iterambere
diakonia.desc: Ishami rya Diyakoniya rihuza serivisi z'imibereho myiza, ubutabazi, n'iterambere rirambye rya CPR. Rikorera abaturage bafite intege nke binyuze mu gahunda zuzuye.
body: Guhuza ubutabazi bw'ikibazo n'ibikorwa byo gufasha mu bihe by'akaga
Gahunda z'iterambere ry'abaturage zibanda ku mikoranire irambye
Kuvura ihungabana n'isanamitima — guhugura abajyanama mu gihugu hose
Gahunda z'amazi, isuku, n'ubuzima (WASH) mu miryango y'icyaro
Kubaka ubushobozi bw'abayobozi b'amatorero mu gucunga imishinga
Gufatanya na Bread for the World, FECCLAHA, n'ibigo by'ubufatanye

finance.title: Imari & Gushaka Ubushobozi
finance.desc: Ishami ry'Imari riteza imbere uburambe bw'ikigo binyuze mu micungire yera y'imari, gushaka ubushobozi mu buryo bw'ingamba, no kugenzura neza.
body: Gutegura ingengo y'imari, gukurikirana, no gutanga raporo ku bafatanyabikorwa
Gucunga inkunga z'abaterankunga no kubahiriza amasezerano y'inkunga
Igenzura ry'imbere, gucunga ibyago, na sisitemu zo kugenzura imari
Gahunda zo gushaka ubushobozi zikubiyemo umusanzu w'amatorero n'ubufatanye
Igiciro, kugura ibikoresho, no gucunga umutungo mu mashami yose
Raporo z'imari za buri gihembwe n'umwaka za Komite Nyobozi

youth.title: Gahunda y'Urubyiruko
youth.desc: Gahunda y'Urubyiruko ifasha urubyiruko rw'u Rwanda binyuze mu mahugurwa y'ubuyobozi ashingiye ku kwizera, gahunda zo kubaka amahoro, n'imishinga y'ubwiyunge.
body: Inama y'Urubyiruko ya buri mwaka ku Mahoro n'Ubwiyunge
Amakambi yo guteza imbere ubuyobozi n'ahugurwa ry'umwuga
Ivagabutumwa rya digitale n'amahugurwa mu itumanaho ku rubyiruko
Amatsinda arwanya ihungabana mu mashuri ateza imbere ubuzima bwo mu mutwe
Gahunda za siporo n'urugendo rw'umuco hagati y'amatorero
Gahunda z'ama bursa n'ubujyanama ku rubyiruko rukomeye

gender.title: Ishami ryo Kwimakaza Uburinganire
gender.desc: Ishami ryo Kwimakaza Uburinganire riteza imbere uburinganire, ubushobozi bw'abagore, no kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina mu matorero n'imiryango ikorana na CPR.
body: Gushyira uburinganire mu mashami yose ya CPR no mu gahunda z'amatorero
Amahugurwa yo gufasha abayobozi b'amatorero mu kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina
Gahunda z'ubushobozi bw'abagore — amatsinda y'ubwigunguri, kooperatibe, n'ubucuruzi
Guteza imbere ubuyobozi bw'abagore mu nzego z'ubuyobozi bw'amatorero
Ubwigenge ku burenganzira bw'abagore no kurinda abana
Gufatanya na leta n'imiryango mpuzamahanga y'abagore

radio.title: Radio Inkoramutima 107.1 FM
radio.desc: Radio Inkoramutima ('Ijwi ry'Umutima') ni radiyo yemewe y'Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda. Itangaza kuva 2005 kuri 107.1 FM, igera mu miryango hirya no hino mu Rwanda.
body: Ibiganiro bya buri munsi by'amasengesho, ubwiriza, n'inyigisho zishingiye ku kwizera
Amakuru y'abaturage, itangazo rusange, n'ubutumwa bw'iterambere
Ibiganiro byo gufasha abafite ihungabana n'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe
Ibiganiro by'urubyiruko n'abagore biteza imbere ubumwe n'amahoro
Gutangaza ibikorwa bya CPR, sinode, n'ibikorwa byo kwibuka
Gufatanya n'izindi radiyo za rubanda n'imiryango iteza imbere itangazamakuru

secretariatPage.heroDesc: Ikigo cy'ingenzi cya CPR — gihuriza imiyoborere, ibikorwa, ubwigenge, no gutumanahana hagati y'amatorero.
secretariatPage.introDesc: Ubunyamabanga Bukuru ni ingingo y'ubuyobozi bwa CPR, ishinzwe gushyira mu bikorwa ibyemezo by'Inteko Rusange n'Komite Nyobozi, gucunga imishyikirano hagati y'amatorera, no guhagararira CPR ku rwego rw'igihugu no mpuzamahanga.

sgProfile.name: Pas. Samuel Mutabazi
sgProfile.title: Umunyamabanga Mukuru, Inama y'Amatorera y'Abaprotestanti mu Rwanda
sgProfile.quote: Amatorera y'Abaprotestanti mu Rwanda arahamagarirwa kuba umwe — gukorera hamwe, guhamya hamwe, no kubaka iki gihugu hamwe. CPR ihari kugira ngo ubumwe bwo bugaragare kandi bukorere mu nzego zose z'u Rwanda.

meetings.title: Imiyoborere & Inama z'Imbere
meetings.desc: Usibye ibikorwa bya rubanda, CPR iterana inama z'imiyoborere buri gihe kugira ngo hagire inshingano, guhuriza hamwe ingamba, no guhuza neza amatorera agize umuryango n'amashami yose.
body: Inama za Komite Nyobozi — ziteranwa buri gihembwe kugira ngo basuzume imikorere y'inzego no kwemeza ibyemezo by'ingenzi
Inteko Rusange — inzego z'ubuyobozi bw'ikirenga, ziteranwa buri mwaka hamwe n'amatorera 25 agize umuryango
Inama za Biro — guhuza buri kwezi hagati y'Umunyamabanga Mukuru n'abayobozi b'amashami
Inama za Komite y'Imari n'Igenzura — kugenzura ingengo y'imari, ibisohotse, n'inyandikomvugo z'inkunga
Inama zo guhuza amatorera — ikiganiro hagati y'amatorera agize umuryango
Inama zo gushyiraho ingamba — ziteranwa buri mwaka kugira ngo basuzume no gusubiramo gahunda y'imyaka itanu ya CPR

sg.title: Ibiro by'Umunyamabanga Mukuru
sg.desc: Umunyamabanga Mukuru ayobora ibikorwa bya buri munsi bya CPR, akaba umuyobozi mukuru w'Inama kandi akaba inzira nyamukuru hagati y'amatorera, leta, n'inshuti z'amahanga.
body: Gushyira mu bikorwa ibyemezo by'Inteko Rusange n'Komite Nyobozi
Guhagararira CPR mu mahuriro y'igihugu no mpuzamahanga
Guhuza amashami yose no gukurikirana imishyikirano y'inzego
Gucunga abakozi, ibibazo by'amategeko, n'imirimo y'ubutegetsi
Kubika inyandiko z'ibikorwa n'inkuru z'inzego
Gukurikirana gahunda z'ibikorwa no gutanga raporo z'imyaka

events.title: Inama, Sinode & Inteko
events.desc: CPR iterana buri gihe inama zihuza abayobozi b'amatorera, abayobozi ba leta, umuryango w'abaturage, n'inshuti z'amahanga kugira ngo bafatanye ibyemezo.
body: Inteko Rusange ya buri mwaka y'amatorera 25 agize umuryango
Sinode za buri myaka ibiri zo gutekereza ku bya teolojiya no gusuzuma politiki
Iminsi y'isengesho ry'igihugu n'ibikorwa byo kwibuka (nk'Iyicibwa ry'Abatutsi)
Inama z'ubukristo hamwe na FECCLAHA n'Inama y'Amatorera y'Isi Yose
Inama z'ubuyobozi n'amahugurwa yo gukomeza ubushobozi
Inteko z'urubyiruko n'abagore kugira ngo bose bagire uruhare

advocacy.title: Kugira Uruhare mu Politiki & Ubuyobozi bw'Abaturage
advocacy.desc: CPR ikora mu buryo bw'umwihariko mu nzego z'amategeko y'igihugu, itwara ijwi ry'umuryango w'Abaprotestanti ku bibazo by'ubutabera, agaciro k'ikiremwamuntu, ubwiyunge, no guteza imbere igihugu.
body: Gufatanya na Leta y'u Rwanda ku bibazo by'uburezi, ubuzima, n'imibereho myiza
Kugira uruhare mu Nama y'Igihugu (Umushyikirano) no mu nama z'Inteko Ishinga Amategeko
Gushyigikira abarokotse Iyicibwa ry'Abatutsi n'abaturage bafite ubukene
Guteza imbere ubwiyunge, ubumwe, n'amahoro hagati y'amatorera
Gukorana na CNLG ku bikorwa byo kwibuka Iyicibwa ry'Abatutsi
Guhagararira CPR ku mahuriro ya AU na ONU

sustainability.title: Uburambe bw'Ibidukikije & bw'Inzego
sustainability.desc: CPR ihamagarira kubungabunga ibidukikije by'u Rwanda no kubaka inzego zirambye, ishyira mu bikorwa teolojiya y'ubungabunga bw'isi.
body: Gahunda za teolojiya y'ibidukikije zishyizwe mu bikorwa by'amatorera
Gutera imitobe no gusubiza ubutaka ubwiza mu matorera agize umuryango
Amahame y'ubwubatsi burambye ashyirwa mu bikorwa mu mashuri n'ivuriro
Uburambe bw'inzego binyuze mu nzira z'inkunga zitandukanye
Gufatanya na REMA n'imiryango mpuzamahanga y'ibidukikije
Raporo z'uburambe za buri mwaka zihuje n'intego z'igihugu

publications.title: Raporo, Amakuru & Intumwa
publications.desc: Ubunyamabanga butanga ibitangazo by'ibikorwa bya CPR, bigaragaza imirimo y'inzego kandi bikamenyesha amatorera agize umuryango n'abaturage.
body: Raporo y'Umwaka — isuzuma ryuzuye ry'ibikorwa n'imari ya CPR
Ikinyamakuru cya buri gihembwe — amakuru avuye mu mashami yose n'amatorera
Intumwa Zidasanzwe — imenyesha ku bibazo by'igihugu n'ubukristo
Amakuru ya Teolojiya — ibiganiro by'Umunyamabanga Mukuru n'abayobozi b'amatorera
Inyandiko z'Ingamba — imyanzuro ku bibazo by'uburezi, ubuzima, n'imibereho
Ibitangazo byo Kwibuka — ibitabo n'ubushingantahe byo kwibuka

cta.title: Twandikire Ubunyamabanga
cta.desc: Ku nyandiko zidasanzwe, gusaba ubufatanye, cyangwa ibibazo by'itangazamakuru, twandikire Ibiro by'Umunyamabanga Mukuru.

radioPage.heroDesc: Ijwi ryemewe ry'Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda, rigera mu miryango ya buri kantu k'igihugu n'ubutumwa bw'ukwizera, ubumwe n'iterambere rusange.
radioPage.introDesc: Radiyo Inkoramutima ("Ijwi ry'Umutima") ni radiyo yemewe y'Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda. Yavutse ku ya 27 Ukuboza 2012, itangaza kuri 107.1 FM — ihuriza hamwe amatorero y'ubumwe bwa CPR, ikwirakwiza Ubutumwa Bwiza, ikanateza imbere iterambere rusange n'imibereho myiza y'abaturage b'u Rwanda.

about.title: Kuva mu Nzozi Igaragiraho Ukuri
about.desc: Imbaba na mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, igitekerezo cya radiyo ya CPR cyakomeje kugaragara mu nama z'inzego z'ubuyobozi bwa CPR — ariko nticyashyirwa mu bikorwa. Minisiteri y'Ubwiza (Evangelisation) yasangaga ko itumanaho rya radiyo ari ngombwa kugira ngo Ubutumwa Bwiza bugere ku bantu benshi mu gihugu, mu karere no ku isi hose.
body: Mu ntangiriro, CPR yahirega umwanya ku Radiyo Rwanda y'igihugu itangira gutangaza ubutumwa bw'ubwiza mu minota 30.
CPR yubatse sitidiyo nto ku biro byayo by'ibanze i Kicukiro, yakoreshwaga n'Ishami ry'Itumanaho n'Ubwiza mu gutegura no guhindura ibiganiro by'ubwiza mbere yo kubitangaza kuri Radiyo Rwanda.

Aya mafaranga y'abaporotesitanti yo ku cyumweru yatangazwaga ku mubonano na Radiyo Rwanda akoresheje sitidiyo ebyiri — imwe kuri katedrali ya Saint Etienne y'I turiri rya Angilika (Dioseze ya Kigali) n'iyindi ku mugaragaro wa Kiyovu w'Itorero rya Presbyteriya.

Mu 2012, Umwanditsi Mukuru wa CPR, hamwe n'itsinda ry'abatekiniki b'Ishami rya Mission na Mobilisation y'Amatorero hamwe n'abatekiniki ba radiyo, bakoranye ubushakashatsi bwo gushinga Radiyo Inkoramutima.
Ku ya 27 Ukuboza 2012, inzozi z'imyaka myinshi zibaye impamo: Radiyo Inkoramutima yavutse.
Uyu munsi sitidiyo ikora amasaha 17 buri munsi — kuva saa kumi n'imwe z'ijoro (5:00) kugeza saa kumi na zine z'ijoro (22:00) — ku biro byayo byo mu Murenge wa Kimihurura, Akarere ka Gasabo, Kigali.

vision.visionDesc: Guhuza abanyamuryango ba CPR mu kwikwiragiza Ubutumwa Bwiza, kurwanya inyigisho z'ibinyoma no guteza imbere iterambere rusange n'imibereho myiza y'abaturage b'u Rwanda by'umwihariko n'isi muri rusange.
vision.missionDesc: Kumenyesha, kurera no guhagurukira abaturage mu nzego zitandukanye z'imibereho y'igihugu.

editorial.title: Ubwiza, Ubumwe n'Iterambere Rusange
editorial.desc: Kuva mu ntangiriro, urukurikirane rw'ibiganiro bya Radiyo Inkoramutima rwubakiye ku nkingi eshatu zishyira mu bikorwa buri kiganiro dutangaza.

items.title: Ubwiza (Evangelisation)
items.desc: Kubwira Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Yesu Kristo binyuze mu masengesho, inyigisho n'ibiganiro by'ukwizera bigera mu miryango ibihumbi buri munsi.

items.title: Ubumwe
items.desc: Guteza imbere ubumwe bw'abizera mu itandukaniro ryabo, gukomeza ubwiyunge bw'igihugu n'umurongo uri hagati y'amatorero y'ubumwe bwa CPR.

items.title: Iterambere Rusange
items.desc: Gushyigikira uburezi, ubuzima, ubuhinzi, ibidukikije n'imibereho myiza binyuze mu biganiro by'ubumenyi n'ubutumwa bw'abaturage.

programs.title: Umunsi Wuzuye w'Ibyiringiro kuri 107.1 FM
programs.desc: Radiyo Inkoramutima itangaza amasaha 17 buri munsi, kuva saa kumi n'imwe z'ijoro (5:00) kugeza saa kumi na zine z'ijoro (22:00), mu biganiro bimenyesha, birera kandi bihagurukira.

items.title: Isengesho ryo mu Gitondo n'Umuziki wa Gospel
items.desc: Tangira umunsi n'isengesho, kuramya no kumviriza umuziki wa gospel ushimishije.

items.title: Amakuru y'Umuryango n'Amamenyekanisha
items.desc: Amakuru y'aho tubana, amamenyekanisha rusange n'ubutumwa bw'iterambere.

items.title: Ubwiza n'Inyigisho
items.desc: Ibyigisho by'amatorero y'ubumwe bwa CPR n'inyigisho z'ukwizera.

items.title: Ubuyobozi mu Byo mu Mutwe n'Ibiganiro
items.desc: Ibiganiro by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe n'ubwiyunge bigera ku bantu bo mu cyaro.

items.title: Ibiganiro by'Urubyiruko n'Abagore
items.desc: Ibiganiro bishyigikira ubumwe bw'abaturage, ubushobozi bw'abagore n'ubuyobozi bw'urubyiruko.

items.title: Uburezi n'Iterambere
items.desc: Ibiganiro by'ubuzima, ubuhinzi, ibidukikije n'uburezi.

items.title: Isengesho ryo ku Mugoroba n'Amaradiyo ku Mubonano
items.desc: Sanga umunsi mu kuramya, isengesho ryo ku mugoroba n'amaradiyo y'ibyicaro ku mubonano.

coverage.title: Ijwi Rirenze Imipaka
coverage.desc: Itangaza kuri 107.1 FM igera ku 65% by'igihugu, Radiyo Inkoramutima imvirwa n'abantu kuva mu burengerazuba kugera mu burasirazuba no kuva mu majyaruguru kugera mu majyepfo y'u Rwanda — no mu bice bimwe by'ibihugu bituberanye.

beneficiaries.title: Gukorera Itorero n'Igihugu
beneficiaries.desc: Radiyo Inkoramutima ikorera amatorero 23 y'Abaporotesitanti bayoboka CPR, imiryango 5 y'Abakristu bayobokamo, ndetse n'abaturage bose b'u Rwanda.

cta.title: Umvirize Radiyo Inkoramutima
cta.desc: Kurikira ibiganiro byacu bya buri munsi kuva saa kumi n'imwe z'ijoro (5:00) kugeza saa kumi na zine z'ijoro (22:00) kuri 107.1 FM — Ijwi ry'Umutima w'Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda.

contactPage.heroDesc: Twishimira kumva ibyo utugiriye. Nubwo ufite ikibazo, igitekerezo cyo gufatanya, cyangwa ushaka kumenya byinshi ku mirimo yacu, itsinda ryacu riri kwiteguye kugufasha.

info.title: Dusanga Mu Buryo Butandukanye
info.desc: Hitamo inzira ikwifitiye — duhora twishimiye gufatanya n'abanyamuryango bacu, abafatanyacyakorera n'inshuti zacu.

form.title: Twishimira Kumva Ibyo Udufitiye
form.desc: Uzuza ifishi iri hepfo maze itsinda ryacu risubize vuba. Porogaramu ya email izafunguka ifite ubutumwa bwawe bwerekerejwe.
form.name: Amazina Yombi
form.subject: Icyegeranyo
form.successDesc: Porogaramu ya email yafungutse ifite ubutumwa bwawe. Niba itafungutse, twandikire kuri cprgs@cpr-rwanda.rw

hours.title: Igihe Ushobora Kutubona
hours.desc: Inzugi zacu zifungura mu byumweru byose. Ku cyumweru, itsinda ryacu ryifatanya n'amasengesho — tuzagusubiza ku wa mbere.

items.q: Itorero ryanjye rikora iki kugira ngo ribe umunyamuryango wa CPR?
items.a: Ubunyamuryango bufunguye amatorero y'Abaporotesitanti n'imiryango ya gikristo mu Rwanda ihuje n'iyerekwa ryacu ry'ubumwe n'iterambere. Wandikire Ikigega Gikuru maze itsinda ryacu rikugirire inzira.

items.q: Ndifata gute ubufatanye na CPR ku mushinga?
items.a: Tubakirira abafatanyacyakorera b'igihugu ndetse n'ab'amahanga. Ohereza ubutumwa ukoresheje ifishi cyangwa wandikire cprgs@cpr-rwanda.rw maze itsinda ryacu risubize mu masaha 48.

items.q: Nshobora gute gushyigikira imirimo ya CPR?
items.a: Ushobora kudushyigikira mu masengesho, ubukorera bushake, cyangwa inkunga. Twandikire maze tuguhere imbaraga zishobora guhindura ubuzima bw'abaturage b'u Rwanda.
Yego rwose. Itsinda ryacu ry'itangazamakuru rikoresha ibyo byifuzo — harimo gutangaza ibirori byacu n'ikiganiro n'abayobozi bacu. Twandikire ubutumwa butandukanye.

items.q: Ibiro by'ikigo cya CPR biherereye he?
items.a: Ibiro byacu biherereye kuri KG 2 Av 4, B.P 79, Kigali, Rwanda — mu mutima w'umurwa mukuru.

cta.title: Urashaka Kuvugana Natwe Mu Buryo Bwihuse?
cta.desc: Duhamagare cyangwa utwandikire maze umunyamuryango w'itsinda ryacu agufashe mu masaha y'akazi.
